channel.title: Al-Jazeera Media Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Al-Jazeera Media Network (aljazeera.com)

item.title: Lamine Yamal gives Barcelona hard-fought 1-0 win at Athletic Bilbao
item.description: Yamal goalkeeps the champions four points clear of Real Madrid at the top of the La Liga standings.

item.title: Trump administration denies reports that Iran captured US soldiers
item.description: The head of Iran's National Security Council had claimed the US was misrepresenting the captures as combat deaths.

item.title: Zelenskyy offers Saudi Arabia’s MBS help countering Iranian drones
item.description: Ukraine's president seeks leverage with low-cost interceptors, as US and Gulf nations burn through Patriot missiles.

item.title: Huge fire rages at Tehran oil depot after Israeli attack
item.description: Footage captured a massive fire raging at the Shahran oil depot in northern Tehran following an Israeli strike.

item.title: Iran war live: Israel bombs Tehran oil depots; Iran hits desalination plant
item.description: Kuwait and Saudi Arabia report more attacks as Trump says the war will only end when Iran's leaders 'cry uncle'.

item.title: Trump says US does not need UK’s aircraft carriers for Iran war
item.description: The president called the Iran war 'already won' as he dismissed reports that the UK was preparing HMS Prince of Wales.

item.title: Flames engulf Kuwaiti high-rise amid Iranian drone strikes
item.description: Flames engulfed Kuwait’s Public Institution for Social Security high-rise headquarters amid a wave of Iranian strikes.

item.title: Rapper-turned-politician Balen Shah’s RSP heads for poll landslide in Nepal
item.description: Shah's party represents a reformist wave reshaping the Himalayan nation's politics since last year’s youth-led uprising.

item.title: Israel strikes busy Beirut hotel in assassination attempt
item.description: Israel has claimed responsibility for an assassination attempt, which killed at least four people, at a Beirut hotel.

item.title: Palestinians risk life and limb to fish in Gaza’s Israeli-controlled sea
item.description: Gaza's fishing industry collapses under Israeli blockade, leaving fishermen risking their lives for minimal catches.
